feeds.title: Oxford Medical Simulation Blog
feeds.description: Oxford Medical Simulation delivers virtual reality medical simulation training - allowing healthcare professionals to practice without risking lives. We are trusted by hospitals and universities worldwide.

feeds.title: Avkin Blog
feeds.description: Avkin was started by a nurse simulationist at the University of Delaware who saw the need for a better way to educate her students. This is an informational nursing simulation blog about current events in the industry, written by Avkin team members and industry thought leaders.

feeds.title: SimX Blog
feeds.description: Built by educators, for educators, SimX was founded by and is still run by MDs, PAs, RNs, and other clinicians. SimX is the only VR medical sim product that works on all major headsets, wired or wireless! From routine clinic visits to multi-trauma cases for field medics. From basic assessment for MA training to postoperative ICU cases for specialists. The SimX system can do it all!

feeds.title: SimRated Blog
feeds.description: Our platform provides an innovative approach where students study the procedure on our online platform and then come to class for hands-on training and instruction. Our mission is to train aspiring healthcare professionals to perform medical procedures in the safest and most effective manner through the use of SimRated's clinician-driven hands-on simulation training, simulation-based assessment, and clinician feedback.

feeds.title: PCS Blog
feeds.description: Team PCS was started in 2015 but our story began back in the 90s when our founders engaged on a journey around patient simulation and standardized patient methodologies. We help sim centers digitally debrief sessions when the alternative was handing out VHS tapes.

feeds.title: Simulation In Motion Blog
feeds.description: Our simulations increase team performance, address communication dynamics, reduce medical errors, improve staff competencies, and improve patient outcomes. Our mission s to deliver simulation-based education to healthcare teams in order to improve patient outcomes.

feeds.title: Simulating Healthcare
feeds.description: Simulating Healthcare is a blog discussing topics related to healthcare simulation. Simulation is an important method for the training and assessment of students, physicians, nurses, and all healthcare provider disciplines. Simulation is an important part of the future for helping to improve quality and safety in healthcare.

feeds.title: Kitware » Medical Simulation
feeds.description: Kitware provides advanced technical computing, state-of-the-art AI, and tailored software solutions to our customers. Our mission is to advance science and technology, empowering global innovation and addressing the world's challenges. The Medical simulation blog is a collection of high-performance, interactive physics-based simulation models, and much more.

feeds.title: Health Scholars Blog
feeds.description: Health Scholars is dedicated to helping nurses and clinicians improve patient outcomes through thorough, evidence-based training. We also believe that learning should be engaging. Our team seeks continuous improvement by asking for feedback, continuing education, and asking for help.

feeds.title: Acadicus Blog
feeds.description: Acadicus is developed by Arch Virtual, a VR/AR development company focused on using these technologies to solve real-world problems. Building on over 7 years of experience delivering enterprise and educational applications for companies like GE Healthcare, ExxonMobil, Suzuki, the NBA, American Family Insurance, Adtalem Global Education, and many others, we created the Acadicus platform with the goal of reducing the cost, time, and complexity of creating VR training experiences.

feeds.title: Veterinary Simulator Industries
feeds.description: We manufacture best-in-class simulators that allow veterinary students to become proficient in their diagnostic and practical skills without the need to endanger or cause unnecessary discomfort to live animals. Our simulators intersect with curriculum requirements to provide maximum benefits to students and educators.

feeds.title: Simovation Blog
feeds.description: Simovation is an Australian-based healthcare education and health simulation service provider. We work with organizations locally, nationally, and internationally. With patient safety as our core focus, our approach supports the design and delivery of bespoke, personalized training solutions which support your organizational capacity and capability by delivering impactful clinical outcomes through simulation-based education, simulated learning environments, immersive technologies, and targeted program development.

feeds.title: ICE Blog » Simulation
feeds.description: The ICE blog promotes discussion among Clinician Educators from around the world, archiving a variety of educational resources. The Simulation blog posts are written by drvictoriabrazil and Michael Gisondi for you to stay updated.

feeds.title: Virtual Medical Coaching Blog
feeds.description: Virtual Medical Coaching is an EdTech company specializing in AR/VR simulations, big data, and artificial intelligence for learning complex or dangerous tasks in a safe, immersive, and realistic environment. Our mission is to deliver the experiences your learner deserves.

feeds.title: SIMZINE News
feeds.description: SIMZINE is a digital and printable magazine, independent, irreverent, and published for information purposes, which promotes the use of simulation in the education and training of health professionals to ensure greater patient safety.

feeds.title: Simulation Man Blog
feeds.description: SimulationMan is a concept business. Set up to provide enablement consultancy to healthcare tech or healthcare education companies looking to meet their marketing and sales expectations. With SimulationMan comes over 20 years of experience working in healthcare and healthcare-related tech businesses.

feeds.title: Gaumard Blog
feeds.description: Gaumard is committed to providing innovative simulation solutions for healthcare education. Our products today are built on a foundation of knowledge and experience in maternal, neonatal, emergency, nursing, respiratory, life support, trauma, and surgical simulation that spans over 65 years.

feeds.title: Immersive Healthcare Blog
feeds.description: The Immersive Healthcare platform immerses health professionals into an educational experience through experiential engagement with the AI Virtual humans in immersive VR and interactive WebXR simulations.
